commit_message: Restore current rigid-body rig public facade
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 engine-native Secondary Motion. This follow-up restores the intentional ADR 0111 `engine::rigid_body_rig` public umbrella path after the compatibility cleanup, while keeping the obsolete pre-ADR-0112 type aliases removed. The facade now exposes only the current types owned by `engine-rig`.

The PR remains Draft while PMX best-effort conversion diagnostics, stale MMD compatibility cleanup, documentation cleanup, and final validation are completed.
